title: HttpResponseEffector
description: Effector archetype for HTTP response emission. HTTP responses have no verb system; response semantics are carried by the status code on the data layer (HttpResponse.statusClass/statusCode). Source: RFC 9110 §15 — Status Codes.

contentType.description: Media type this effector declares it will send in response bodies (e.g., 'application/json'). Port-level contract: declares the effector's output format. Source: RFC 9110 §8.3 — Content-Type.
